name: DeckInsightAI
short_description: NLP/AI agent that reads a Keynote/PowerPoint deck, understands its content, and summarises it in the voice of a Head of Department (or executive).
description:
## Deck Insight AI — Presentation Analyst

Deck Insight AI ingests a presentation (`.key` Apple Keynote or `.pptx` PowerPoint), extracts the text from every slide with a zero-dependency parser, and uses an LLM to produce a structured, audience-tuned briefing.

### What it does
- **Parses decks natively** — reads Keynote IWA (Snappy-compressed protobuf) and PowerPoint Open XML using only Node built-ins (no cloud upload required to extract text).
- **Understands the content** — identifies the process/topic, ordered steps, critical configuration values, and compliance-sensitive fields.
- **Summarises as a persona** — default **Head of Department**: executive summary, what the process does, key steps, critical data & configuration, risks & compliance watch-outs, and recommendations. An `exec` (C-suite) persona is also built in.

### Model strategy (local-first, like the rest of the swarm)
Ollama (local, free) → Groq → Gemini → Claude → OpenAI → offline extractive fallback. It always produces output, even with no model and no network.

### Example
Run against an SAP `Customer Creation` (T-Code XD01) SOP deck, it returns a Head-of-Department briefing that surfaces the fixed values (Account Group Z002, Company Code 2100, Reconciliation Account 11000000), the regulated GST / Drug-License fields, and the Sold-to / Ship-to partner codes — plus the controls a department head should put in place.

### Usage
```bash
node main.js deck.key                       # Head of Department briefing
node main.js deck.pptx --persona exec        # C-suite summary
node main.js deck.key --out brief.md --json  # save + machine-readable
```

capabilities.name: deck_parsing
capabilities.description: Extracts slide text from Apple Keynote (.key) and PowerPoint (.pptx) files using a zero-dependency reader (custom ZIP + Snappy + Open XML).

capabilities.name: content_understanding
capabilities.description: Identifies the topic, ordered process steps, critical configuration values, and compliance-sensitive fields within a presentation.

capabilities.name: persona_summarization
capabilities.description: Writes a structured briefing in a chosen voice — Head of Department (default) or Executive — grounded strictly in the deck's content.

capabilities.name: smart_model_routing
capabilities.description: Routes to the best available model (Ollama, Groq, Gemini, Claude, OpenAI) and degrades to a deterministic offline summary when none are reachable.

pricing: First summary free. 0.5 USDC per deck summary.
